pro_course_detail.title: Interview Preparation (expertise in U.S. Government Jobs)
pro_course_detail.description:
Hi there! 

Whether you have a job interview in the government or in the private sector, I can support you to BE your best. I highlight the word BE because I believe the key to a successful interview is feeling confident and at ease, so that your authentic self and capabilities naturally come through.  

I worked eight years as a spokesperson for a U.S.government agency. I was interviewed hundreds of times for radio/TV shows and newspapers.  Looking back, it is hard to believe.  I am naturally an introvert and in my early professional years I could not sleep the night before a presentation. I took many trainings and learned many cognitive skills to cope with my nervousness.  However, what really helped me was learning about how the nervous systems works and simple, yet potent, practices to stay present in my body while connecting to others. 

In addition, I have interviewed hundreds of potential job candidates for U.S government positions.  The majority of the candidates I recommended were hired successfully.  I have a gift for aligning the right candidate with the right manager.  

I look forward to sharing my experience with you.   Here are some of the services I offer: 

•	Create customized interview questions based on your resume and the job description.  (If you would like me to create customized interview questions, please send me your resume and job description in advance.) 

•	Conduct a practice interview during which I will give you feedback on how to communicate verbally and non-verbally in a clear and confident manner.   

•	Enhance your vocabulary with Business English expressions.

•	Provide suggestions on how to answer "tricky" questions and what to ask. 

•	Help  you identify strengths that might not be apparent to you.  

•	Help you explore if the job is aligned with your experience, values, and goals.

•	Introduce you to some practices that will help you minimize your normal nervousness by staying connected to your body and the environment.

pro_course_detail.title: Preparación para entrevistas (experta en empleos del gobierno de Estados Unidos)
pro_course_detail.description:
¡Saludos! 
Si tiene una entrevista de trabajo ya sea con el sector privado o con el gobierno de los Estados  puedo ayudarle a SER lo mejor posible. Destaco la palabra SER porque creo que la clave del éxito de una entrevista es sentirse seguro y cómodo, para que su auténtico yo y sus capacidades se expresen de forma natural.  

Trabajé ocho años como portavoz de una agencia del gobierno de los Estados Unidos. Me entrevistaron cientos de veces para programas de radio, televisión y periódicos.  Mirando atrás, es difícil de creer.  Soy introvertida por naturaleza y en mis primeros años profesionales no podía dormir la noche anterior a una presentación. Tomé muchos cursos de formación y aprendí muchas habilidades cognitivas para hacer frente a mi nerviosismo.  Sin embargo, lo que realmente me ayudó fue aprender cómo funciona el sistema nervioso y prácticas sencillas, pero potentes, para mantenerme presente en mi cuerpo mientras conectaba con los demás. 

Además, he entrevistado a cientos de candidatos para puestos en el gobierno de los Estados Unidos.  La mayoría de los que recomendé  fueron contratados.  

Deseo compartir mi experiencia con usted.  A continuación describo algunos de los servicios que puedo ofrecerle: 
•	Crear preguntas personalizadas con base en su resume y la descripción del trabajo. (Si desea que prepare preguntas personalizadas, por favor envíeme estos documentos con anticipación.)  
•	Hacer una simulación de entrevista en la que le daré sugerencias sobre como comunicarse de manera verbal y no verbal en un modo claro y con confianza. 
•	Compartir expresiones usadas en el Español  para negocios. 
•	Proveerle sugerencias sobre cómo responder a preguntas difíciles.
•	Identificar fortalezas de las cuales quizás no se haya percatado.
•	Ayudarle a explorar si el trabajo se ajusta a su experiencia, valores y metas. 
•	Compartir algunas práctica que le ayudarán a minimizar su nerviosismo normal al mantenerse conectado con su cuerpo y ambiente.

After receiving a Masters of Teaching in 2010 and TEFL certification in 2015, I have been teaching English as a second language to foreign language learners at a large language school. I've had the opportunity to teach hundreds of students from a variety of countries, ranging from beginners to advanced/fluent. I have taught group lessons and private lessons. I specialize in private lessons and have multiple repeat students who I have been teaching for years now. They are on the path to complete fluency, which is something I am proud of. 

My classes focus on vocabulary, grammar, and pronunciation (accent reduction). I teach structured lessons with topics such as business, travel, conversation, and other necessities. Additionally, I love unstructured, casual lessons (if that is what you want), but understand the importance of structured classes. 

Teaching online has shown me that students learn in a variety of ways, some being more effective than others. After each lesson, I provide feedback on what students have done well and the steps they can take to improve their skills. 

One of my other responsibilities is as an academic writing skills tutor for two large universities, where I help students develop their academic English skills and fix grammar, sentence structure, and spelling issues. I do these corrections in British English and American English, depending on the student's preferred writing style. 

Finally, I spend most of my time abroad and am therefore familiar with the difficulties of communicating in a foreign language when you have not developed the necessary skills to communicate clearly and effectively. I am here to help you improve your communication skills so you can avoid the problems and awkward situations I have when doing business, traveling, or any other activity using a foreign language. Best wishes!

pro_course_detail.title: English for Daily Life - Practical English
pro_course_detail.description:
“English for Daily Life” is about the vocabulary necessary in order to live in a foreign country, so the class is perfect for people who live in a foreign country or who are planning to move. I have lived in three different countries, so I know you will definitely need to be familiar with these topics.

We learn things like:
* Going to the doctor
* Calling the police
* Calling an ambulance
* Going to the dentist
* Going to the post office
* Going to the vet
* Buying something at the grocery store
* Calling the government
* Calling the immigration department
* Filling out forms and paperwork
* Insurance vocabulary
* Rental contracts
* Sending a letter
* Introducing yourself to your neighbors
* Many more!

Before class I will send you a list of topics and you can choose the ones you want to learn. I will send topic-related vocabulary and we will practice the vocabulary and dialogues during class together.  

If you want a class similar to those you took in school (with a focus on vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, and other skills) please schedule GENERAL ENGLISH. In General English classes, we learn topics like describing food, talking about hobbies, going on vacation, etc. "English for Daily Life" is about living and communicating when you live abroad.

pro_course_detail.description:
All components of general English (speaking, listening, writing, grammar, and vocabulary) are in this course! General English lessons are traditional and have structured activities. First we learn something, then practice what we learned, and end class with a conversation or role play activity to practice what you learned. These classes are for level B1 and above. I cannot teach beginners now.

In each class, we:
1. Learn grammar rules, vocabulary, pronunciation, and listening. 
2. Do activities to practice what we've learned. (Fill in the blank, complete the sentence, match the dialogue with a response, put vocabulary in a category, etc.)
3. Do a role play or have a conversation to use what we learned earlier and speak naturally.

Lessons teach all aspects of language, including grammar, pronunciation, vocabulary, conversational English, reading, and writing skills. 

We use the following materials:
* Textbooks (I have textbooks or the student can bring their own)
* Powerpoint presentations
* Websites
* News articles and stories.

Classes are best for teenage and adult students, but I can teach children.

pro_course_detail.description:
Do you need help preparing for IELTS, TOEFL, or the Duolingo English Test (DET)? In this Test Prep class we practice the exam in order to build confidence with answering difficult questions in an exam setting. 

We primarily work on speaking skills, such as vocabulary building and grammar. For speaking, we focus on fluency and confidence building and answer questions similar to those on the test. We go over how to make a good answer and how to make sure topics transition smoothly from one point to the next. 

Writing practice is typically assigned as homework and is checked during class. We will look at essay structure, transitioning, paragraphs, and vocabulary. There is an offline writing service available too. See below for information.
--

OFFLINE WRITING SERVICE!
I will proofread and edit your responses to practice IELTS, TOEFL, or DET questions. Book an hour lesson and I will send you your writing prompts. Then you send me your answer and I will check it for spelling, grammar, word choice, and provide advice on what you've done well and what you should improve. The writing service is offline, which means we do not meet together for class. You send me your writing and I send you a corrected document.

pro_course_detail.title: (English for beginners) Inglés para principiantes
pro_course_detail.description:
This comprehensive ESL course is structured to take students from beginner to high-beginner proficiency.  By completing this course, students will gain confidence in speaking, listening, reading, and writing in English, preparing them for real-world communication.  

The course focuses on:  
- **Grammar**: Progressing from basic structures (*be verbs*, *present simple*, *past simple*, *future (going to)*) to more complex structures (*can/can't, comparatives, superlatives, present perfect*).  
- **Vocabulary**: Covering a wide range of topics, including numbers, nationalities, family, food, daily routines, and more.  
- **Pronunciation**: Emphasizing key English sounds, stress patterns, and rhythm to develop clear spoken communication.  
- **Speaking & Listening**: Engaging activities, dialogues, and real-life conversations to improve fluency and comprehension.  
- **Reading & Writing**: Practicing sentence structure, reading comprehension, and writing tasks ranging from simple messages to structured paragraphs.  
- **Practical English**: Everyday functional language, such as ordering food, asking for directions, making small talk, and handling real-world situations.  
- **Cultural Awareness & Communication**: Exploring cultural differences in communication, idiomatic expressions, and social norms.  
- **Review & Progress Checks**: Regular revision exercises and practical challenges to reinforce learning and track progress.

pro_course_detail.title: (English for intermediate students) Inglés para estudiantes intermedios
pro_course_detail.description:
Intermediate ESL Course for Confident Communication

This course is designed to help students at an intermediate level develop fluency and accuracy in English through engaging lessons that focus on:

Grammar Mastery: Strengthening sentence structures, tenses, and complex grammatical forms to express ideas clearly.
Expanded Vocabulary: Learning and using a wide range of words and phrases for everyday conversations, work, and travel.
Pronunciation Practice: Improving clarity and natural rhythm in speech through targeted exercises.
Speaking & Listening Skills: Engaging in discussions, role-plays, and real-world scenarios to build confidence in communication.
Reading & Writing Development: Understanding diverse texts, improving comprehension, and refining writing skills for emails, reports, and storytelling.
Practical English for Everyday Situations: Handling real-life interactions such as ordering in restaurants, solving travel problems, and making social connections.
Cultural Awareness & Social English: Navigating conversations with native speakers and understanding language in different contexts.
Regular Progress Checks: Reviewing learning through assessments and interactive activities to reinforce knowledge.
By the end of this course, students will have the tools to communicate effectively in a variety of real-life situations, gaining confidence and proficiency in English

pro_course_detail.title: (English for upper intermediate students) Inglés para estudiantes de nivel intermedio superior
pro_course_detail.description:
**Advanced ESL Course for Effective Communication**  
This is a well-structured, practical, and engaging curriculum. Each phase builds on the previous one, reinforcing knowledge while introducing new grammatical concepts in a way that feels organic and applicable to real-life communication.

This course is designed for students who want to refine their English skills and achieve a higher level of fluency and accuracy.

 The lessons focus on:  
- **Advanced Grammar & Structures**: Mastering complex sentence forms, including passive voice, conditionals, relative clauses, and reported speech.  
- **Expanded Vocabulary & Expressions**: Learning idiomatic expressions, phrasal verbs, and specialized vocabulary for different contexts.  
- **Pronunciation & Intonation**: Developing a natural rhythm and clarity in speech through stress and intonation practice.  
- **Speaking & Listening in Real Situations**: Engaging in debates, storytelling, and discussions on various topics to build confidence in spontaneous conversation.  
- **Reading & Writing for Different Purposes**: Analyzing and producing formal and informal texts, including essays, reports, and narratives.  
- **Functional & Social English**: Navigating professional and social interactions, handling difficult conversations, and expressing nuanced opinions.  
- **Cultural Insights & Language in Context**: Understanding language variations, cultural references, and communication styles.  
- **Comprehensive Review & Practical Application**: Regular assessments and real-life applications to track progress and solidify learning.  

By the end of this course, students will have the skills to communicate effectively in both casual and professional environments, enhancing their confidence in English.

pro_course_detail.title: Advanced ESL Course for Mastery and Fluency
pro_course_detail.description:
**Advanced ESL Course for Mastery and Fluency**  

This course is designed for students who want to achieve full fluency and command of English at an advanced level. The lessons focus on:  

- **Sophisticated Grammar & Nuanced Structures**: Exploring advanced topics such as past modals, inversion, ellipsis, cleft sentences, and distancing language to enhance precision in communication.  
- **Rich & Diverse Vocabulary**: Expanding knowledge of idioms, phrasal verbs, colloquial expressions, and topic-based vocabulary in areas like psychology, business, and global issues.  
- **Pronunciation & Intonation Refinement**: Perfecting natural rhythm, connected speech, and stress patterns for clear, confident, and native-like pronunciation.  
- **Speaking & Listening in Complex Contexts**: Engaging in in-depth discussions, debates, and professional conversations, and understanding a variety of accents and fast-paced speech.  
- **Reading & Writing for Academic & Professional Purposes**: Analyzing complex texts, writing structured essays, reports, and opinion pieces, and refining formal and informal writing styles.  
- **Social & Professional Communication**: Mastering English for networking, interviews, presentations, and persuasive discussions in both formal and casual settings.  
- **Cultural Awareness & Idiomatic English**: Understanding how language reflects cultural nuances, improving adaptability in global communication.  
- **Personalized Review & Application**: Frequent assessments, real-life simulations, and practical exercises to ensure measurable progress.  

By the end of this course, students will have achieved an advanced level of fluency, enabling them to communicate naturally and effectively in any setting, from academic to professional and everyday life.
